# Observer

> Observer delivers news, data and insights on the most important people and forces shaping business, finance, technology, arts, media and culture.

Observer is a premium publication covering influential leaders and trends across business, finance, technology, arts, and lifestyle sectors. The site combines breaking news with in-depth interviews, market analysis, and cultural commentary from industry experts and thought leaders.

## Key Topics

- AI innovation
- Tech leaders
- Fintech
- Art market
- Contemporary art
- Startup founders
- Market analysis
- Art fairs
- Art galleries
- Prediction markets
- Billionaires and wealth
- Media industry
- Finance and banking
- Artist interviews
- Luxury lifestyle

## Core News & Sections

- [Observer Homepage](https://observer.com): News, data and insights on business, arts, tech and culture
- [Business](https://observer.com/business): Coverage of leaders in media, technology, finance and startups
- [Technology](https://observer.com/technology): Focus on AI, big tech, space and emerging technology leaders
- [Finance](https://observer.com/finance): Hedge funds, banking, private equity and IPOs analysis
- [Media](https://observer.com/media): Streaming, Hollywood and entertainment industry leadership
- [Arts](https://observer.com/arts): Museum reviews, exhibitions, auctions and artist interviews
- [Lifestyle](https://observer.com/lifestyle): Luxury guides covering dining, travel, fashion and events

## Business & Leadership

- [Expert Insights & Business Leadership](https://observer.com/column/expert-insights): Op-eds and expert insights on business trends from industry leaders
- [Business Interviews](https://observer.com/interviews-with-business-leaders): Interviews with top CEOs and founders in tech, finance and media
- [Wealth](https://observer.com/wealth): Profiles of billionaires, their strategies and ultra-wealthy lifestyle

## Art Market & Galleries

- [Art Market](https://observer.com/art-market): Art market news, interviews and analysis of collectors, galleries and trends
- [Art Fairs](https://observer.com/art-fairs): Coverage of art fairs with previews, reviews and emerging talent insights
- [Art Reviews](https://observer.com/art-reviews): Critical art reviews exploring exhibitions within art history and cultural context
- [Auctions](https://observer.com/auctions): Auction coverage analyzing results and their impact on global art trends
- [Galleries](https://observer.com/galleries): Gallery exhibition reviews and news about gallerists, dealers and curators
- [Museums](https://observer.com/museums): Museum coverage exploring art stories and visionaries preserving cultural heritage
- [Interviews With Art World Leaders](https://observer.com/interviews-with-arts-leaders): Interviews with curators, dealers, artists and collectors in the art world

## Policy & Regulation

- [Policy](https://observer.com/policy): AI regulation, copyright law, EV and tech policy coverage

## Dining & Nightlife

- [Nightlife & Dining](https://observer.com/nightlife-dining): Restaurant and nightlife reviews with interviews of chefs and restaurateurs

## Optional

- [Subscribe](https://observer.com/subscribe): Newsletter subscription for Observer Daily, Business, Arts and Lifestyle
